cohort_total_n_excerpt: During a mean follow-up of 13.9 years, 7,115 incident cases were identified among 75,216 white, African-American, Native Hawaiian, Japanese American, and Latino men.
reason: The abstract reports incident prostate cancer overall but does not analyze an aggressive, high-grade, advanced, metastatic, or lethal incident endpoint.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: Among selected lifestyle-related factors including body mass index, height, education, physical activity, and intakes of alcohol, calcium, legumes, lycopene, and selenium, only smoking (RR for current (≥20 cigarettes/day) vs. never smoking = 0.72; 95 % CI 0.63-0.83) and history of diabetes (RR for yes vs. no = 0.78; 95 % CI 0.72-0.85) were significantly associated with prostate cancer risk.
estimate_classifications.reason: The legume estimate concerns overall incident prostate cancer; no aggressive endpoint is reported.
